title: Set environment variables for systemd user services
summary: Define environment variables that will be available to systemd user services. This is necessary because user services do not inherit variables from your shell profile (like .bashrc).

aliases.text: set env var for systemd user

steps.explain: Create a .conf file in ~/.config/environment.d/ with lines of the form NAME=VAL. This affects only that user's user unit.
Reload the systemd user manager to apply the changes.

verify.expect: Your new variables should appear in the list.

rollback.explain: Remove the configuration file you created from ~/.config/environment.d/.

warnings: User services do not inherit variables from .bashrc or .profile. You must set them explicitly here.
